info.prompt: A neon-drenched cyber-gothic casino interior where obsidian neural towers rise from a void-black marble floor, their skeletal gold filigree pulsing with bioluminescent amber veins, casting long shadows across a crystalline Farkle board where prismatic dice faces hover in mid-air, each facet etched with glowing numerals visible only when selected, the entire scene framed by a terminal-style hacker overlay scrolling real-time chain probabilities in green matrix code.
